title: NACD Directors Summit 2026: Eric Ries on the mainstage
summary: Eric gave the mainstage keynote on Incorruptible at the National Association of Corporate Directors' annual Directors Summit (October 11 to 14, Gaylord National Harbor, outside Washington, DC; 1,700+ board directors), opening Tuesday morning ahead of a fireside with Mark Weinberger. NACD's own account afterwards published the line he left the room with, putting the board's responsibility for the mission in the directors' own language.
blockquote: “Boards, you have the ultimate responsibility. You are the mission guardians. Do better.”
blockquote_source: NACD (National Association of Corporate Directors) on LinkedIn, quoting the Summit keynote
